title: Ablaze Charred Croatian Quinoa Pilaf
description: Charred quinoa cooked with aromatic Croatian herbs and a splash of local olive oil creates a fluffy, low‑glycemic pilaf that bursts with smoky flavor. The dish pairs well with grilled vegetables or a light yogurt dip.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water until runoff clear.
Bring water and quinoa to a boil in a saucepan.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until quinoa is tender and water is absorbed, about 15 minutes.
Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil over pan and add minced garlic, toasting until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the cooked quinoa to the pan, sprinkle with oregano, paprika, and salt, and char gently, stirring occasionally, until a smoky crust forms, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in lemon zest and remaining olive oil.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
